ui.intro: A field guide to public, historical, experimental and internal GitHub profile badges.
ui.limits: This covers publicly documented badges. Undisclosed internal experiments cannot be exhaustively verified.
ui.incident: GitHub reported award/display delays on 2026-09-23; missing badges do not prove retirement.
ui.active_note: Thresholds are observed by the community; GitHub does not publish a complete eligibility specification. Private activity can count when enabled.
ui.retired_note: These events have ended. Existing awards may remain visible; new contributions cannot unlock them.
ui.experimental_note: GitHub confirmed the March 2026 reappearance was accidental; no public release date is announced.
ui.internal_note: These reflect internal Proxima milestones; there is no public earning procedure or confirmed retirement date.
ui.tiers_note: Default → bronze → silver → gold. x2/x3/x4 are tier labels, not arithmetic multipliers. Since 2026-09-11 profiles show the highest tier.
ui.experimental_tiers: Experimental artwork exists. The following thresholds are provisional community reports, not verified public earning rules.
ui.variants_note: Skin-tone artwork for Starstruck and Quickdraw changes appearance, not eligibility or achievement count.
ui.highlights_note: Highlights are program/account labels, distinct from achievement medals. Availability follows the relevant program.
ui.history_note: The three original designs date from 2021-04-19 to the redesign on 2022-06-09; aliases are not additional achievements.
ui.proxima_note: The supplied screenshots match live Proxima cards. Pioneer: M0 prototype contribution; Staffshipper: M8 instance launch; Staffuser: team onboarding.
ui.inaccessible_note: “inaccessible” means the underlying event is private to viewers. Staffshipper is dated 2024-08-22 in the screenshot, but 2024-08-21 in UTC.
ui.sources_note: Official announcements establish status; profile cards establish awarded events; community thresholds remain observations.

descriptions.starstruck: Create a repository that reaches **16 stars**. Higher tiers depend on that repository’s star count.
descriptions.pull-shark: Author **2 pull requests** that are merged. Counts refer to merged PRs you opened.
descriptions.pair-extraordinaire: Coauthor commits in **1 merged pull request**; use a correctly attributed `Co-authored-by` trailer.
descriptions.galaxy-brain: Have **2 answers accepted** in GitHub Discussions. Awards in `github.com/orgs/community` were disabled on 2024-02-06.
descriptions.quickdraw: Close an issue or pull request **within 5 minutes** of opening it.
descriptions.yolo: Merge your own pull request **without a code review**. Detailed eligibility is not officially specified.
descriptions.public-sponsor: Publicly sponsor an eligible maintainer or organization through **GitHub Sponsors**.
descriptions.arctic-code-vault-contributor: Contribute to a qualifying repository included in the **2020-02-02 Arctic Code Vault snapshot**. The snapshot is closed.
descriptions.mars-2020-contributor: Author a commit included in one of the specific project versions used by **NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. The event has ended.
descriptions.heart-on-your-sleeve: Experimental association: ❤️ reactions. GitHub removed the accidental March 2026 rollout; a reaction today is not a confirmed unlock method.
descriptions.open-sourcerer: Experimental association: merged PRs across public repositories. Exact counting and eligibility are not publicly specified.
descriptions.proxima-pioneer: **M0 Participant** — contributed to the **Proxima proof of concept (POC)**. Observed on @JakubOleksy.
descriptions.proxima-staffshipper: **M8 Participant** — shipped a **Proxima Staffship instance**. Observed on @JakubOleksy.
descriptions.proxima-staffuser: Team participation — **onboarded to Proxima**. Observed on @timrogers; this is the third known Proxima award.

highlights.developer-program: Join the GitHub Developer Program and build an app using the GitHub API.
highlights.bug-bounty: Report qualifying GitHub security vulnerabilities through the bounty program.
highlights.campus-expert: Participate in the GitHub Campus Experts program; check current application rules.
highlights.security-advisory: Receive an accepted security advisory credit in the GitHub Advisory Database.
highlights.github-star: Be selected for the GitHub Stars program; this is not a repository star-count achievement.
highlights.discussion-answered: Historical highlight for accepted Discussion answers; replacement by Galaxy Brain was reported in 2022.
